quotes.text: It's not the years in your life that count. It's the life in your years.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.text: The mind and body are not separate. What affects one, affects the other.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The secret of health for both mind and body is not to mourn for the past, nor to worry about the future, but to live the present moment wisely.
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.text: Age is an issue of mind over matter. If you don't mind, it doesn't matter.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.text: Where the mind goes, the body follows.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: The greatest revolution of our generation is the discovery that human beings, by changing the inner attitudes of their minds, can change the outer aspects of their lives.
quotes.author: William James

quotes.text: You cannot always control what goes on outside. But you can always control what goes on inside.
quotes.author: Wayne Dyer

quotes.text: In every walk in with nature, one receives far more than they seek.
quotes.author: John Muir

quotes.text: A truly rich man is one whose children run into his arms when his hands are empty.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Wisdom is knowing what to overlook.
quotes.author: William James

quotes.text: Growing older is a privilege denied to many.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The best thing about the future is that it comes one day at a time.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.text: The good life is one inspired by love and guided by knowledge.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.text: Health is a state of complete harmony of the body, mind and spirit.
quotes.author: B.K.S. Iyengar

quotes.text: Do not go where the path may lead, go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.
quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci

quotes.text: You are never too old to become younger.
quotes.author: Mae West

quotes.text: Fifty is the youth of old age.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo

quotes.text: The best mirror is an old friend.
quotes.author: George Herbert

quotes.text: The soul is healed by being with children.
quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky

quotes.text: Silence is a source of great strength.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.
quotes.author: Anaïs Nin

quotes.text: A tree with strong roots laughs at storms.
quotes.author: Malay proverb

quotes.text: Rest is the price you pay for rich attention.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The best years are the ones you almost missed by being too busy.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Your body has carried you every day of your life. Care for it.

quotes.text: Every wrinkle earned tells a story worth remembering.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The best kind of wealth is unhurried time.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Sleep is the finest medicine of all.

quotes.text: Age gives you permission to say no gracefully.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The heart's true wealth is the friendships kept.

quotes.text: The days you feel your best are the days you slept well.

quotes.text: Time softens edges. Let it.

quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: You do not have to earn a good night's sleep. You need it.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Notice what you can still do, not what you can't.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: A calm life is the achievement of a lifetime.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Life is a school; we graduate when we learn to be kind to ourselves.

quotes.text: The best is often what is quietly happening now.
